rows.behavior: kmctl check passes on a repository whose docs/README.md and .okf/ indexes list every page, concept and section in the defined entry format.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits nonzero or reports a finding on the passing fixture

rows.behavior: A page or concept with no entry in its index fails, naming the file.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits 0, or the finding does not name the unlisted file under check name index

rows.behavior: An index entry whose file does not exist fails, naming the index and line.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits 0, or the finding lacks the index file and line

rows.behavior: An .okf/ section not linked from the root index fails.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits 0 when a section folder has no root index link

rows.behavior: A repository with no docs/ folder passes and reports docs as skipped.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits nonzero, or does not report docs as skipped

rows.behavior: kmctl check --json prints a list of findings, each with check, file, line and message.
rows.fails_when: stdout is not a JSON list, or a finding lacks any of the four keys
